title: Authority citation record
description: A legal authority or dated practice source that law rules cite. Lives in open-law/citations/registry.json; the location carries the role (the former top-level citations/ registry's reading records live in open-lore/).

lang.description: Language of the primary source (two-letter code, e.g. 'ko'); absent means English.

translation.description: An official-translation pointer rendered beside a non-English primary locator (e.g. the KLRI English translation of a Korean statute). The primary url/locator stay authoritative.

lang.description: Language of the translation; absent means English.
